verdict.rationale: Manufact is a hosting, deploy, testing and observability platform for MCP servers that developers build or connect themselves, so a prebuilt integration catalog is a fair question for it. The evidence shows deploy-from-template and connect-your-own-URL flows, plus a public MCP catalog of readiness scores. Nothing shows a library of hundreds or thousands of ready-made third-party app or API integrations reachable through the platform.
